mga_table.source: NASA GSFC IDC Table VI-1, NTRS 20120013284, adapted from AIAA S-120-2006 Table 1
mga_table.system_margin_note: the same source adds a system-level margin, typically 30% for Pre-Phase-A concepts, above the itemized MGA; not applied in the itemized case

faces.note: SR-200 faces sized by the line's buckling/strength account; no hardware

charged_joining.note: film, scarf, splice, seal from rules and catalog areal masses; process unqualified (038 T2)

coating.note: MLCCAg recipe 7.5752 g/m2 plus its own +10% (048)

systems.note: the 100 kg systems allowance (its own margin)

water.note: assumed 0.1 kg/m2 retained exterior water (048); its own case

SiC_tubes.note: SiC members sized by the frame account; process unproven

joint_sleeves_and_allowance.note: sleeves; above the actual sleeves the item is its own allowance

PBO_two_plies.note: two-ply PBO film sized by stress

barrier_and_protection.note: PET, Al, attachment, white finish, seams (052)

vacuum_service.note: additional 50 kg service charge (top of the 30-50 kg band)

sag_lift_debit.note: calculated buoyancy loss from film sag, not hardware mass
